classifiedDifferences.detail: Foundry represents spellbook preparation, spell slots, and class grants through system Item/Advancement documents; Oracle keeps spellbook, prepared collections, slot pools, and level grants as explicit canonical mechanics.
Foundry subclass features are provider documents; Oracle stores Evoker features as canonical subclassFeature entities linked by stable IDs.
Oracle preserves 5etools SRD 5.2 as import authority; Foundry is used only as an architecture cross-check.
